newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan plans to register illegal immigrants.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan plans to register illegal immigrants.

text.p: Pakistan's Interior Ministry is considering a proposal to register illegal immigrants in the country, Sindh province Chief Minister Liaquat Jatoi said on Tuesday.
He told a news conference that there more than 1.6 million illegal immigrants in Sindh, of which the port city of Karachi is the capital.
"They use our resources, but pay nothing," he said.
The Interior Ministry is working on a proposal for their registration, which will generate revenues, he said, but did not eloborate.
Karachi, Pakistan's commercial hub, attracts thousands of illegal immigrants every year from Bangladesh, Afghanistan, India, Iran, Vietnam, Burma and several African countries.
The immigrants run small businesses or provide cheap labour.

Previous prime minister Benazir Bhutto had held the illegal aliens responsible for a surge in crime and violence in Karachi and had planned a crackdown, but rolled it back in the face of bitter resistance and fears of Government officials say there are large squatter settlements of illegal immigrants in Karachi.
